messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Console observability work this quarter. core pillars on the table: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown (per-route/per-token), and error analytics. customers (Acme, FinCo) have pushed for cost per-route + download/export. what can we realistically ship in an MVP?

Raj (GTM): +1 urgency from customers. they care most about cost visibility (per-route) and a simple way to export reports for finance. dashboards nice-to-have but less urgent.

Kim (Eng): engineering constraints: cost breakdown requires token attribution across batching/kv-cache; tracing hooks need lightweight headers propagated through runtime. rough estimate: dashboards + cost estimation MVP = 3 sprints; adding sampled tracing + trace->logs link = +1 sprint; advanced error analytics (root cause grouping, anomaly detection) = +2 sprints.

Diego (SRE): rollout concerns: sampling defaults, retention, and storage costs. if we enable traces for too many requests we'll blow storage and affect latency. suggest sampled tracing at 0.5% default and feature flag per-customer for higher sampling.

Alix (Support): customers repeatedly ask for CSV export and scheduled reports. they also expect billing reconciliation support — a +/- tolerance threshold would reduce noisy tickets.

Nora (Data): we need a stable join key to connect traces, metrics, and cost events. proposing: route_id + request_id (propagated) + model_variant. schema change needed in telemetry pipeline. also will need daily aggregation job for per-route cost.

Maya (PM): proposing pragmatic MVP (scope negotiation):
- MVP scope: dashboards (high-level usage + top 20 routes), per-route cost estimates (daily rollups, CSV export), basic tracing hooks (sampled traces w/ request_id, link to logs), simple error analytics (group by error type + count).
- Out-of-scope for MVP: full distributed tracing for all requests, advanced anomaly detection, long retention (>30d) for traces.

Kim (Eng): can do MVP if we accept: 1) cost estimates as heuristic (not penny-exact) initially, 2) tracing limited to sampled requests + customers with dedicated pools, 3) retention 7-30d depending on storage budget.

Raj (GTM): that's acceptable if we set clear launch criteria and messaging: "cost estimates" not invoices, and give customers export + reconciliation guide.

Diego (SRE): launch criteria I'd push for: sampling default <=1%, tracing sampling configurable per-tenant, circuit-breaker if ingestion > X rps, and observability alerts for pipeline lag.

Maya (PM): proposed launch criteria (draft):
- docs and UX: walkthrough + CSV export + admin toggle for sampling
- accuracy: per-route daily cost within 5-10% vs ground truth on test workloads
- reliability: tracing ingestion <1% error rate on canary for 48h
- performance: no >5% p95 latency regression on Console operations in canary customers
- rollout: canary on 3 customers (1 small, 1 mid, 1 large) for 2 weeks then staged ramp

Alix (Support): add SLAs for support turnaround on billing queries for first 90 days after launch.

Nora (Data): action items for data infra: schema PR + aggregation job + sample dataset for accuracy tests. estimate: 2 sprints for pipeline work if we parallelize.

Kim (Eng): action items for runtime: add request_id propagation, lightweight trace header, opt-in sampling flag, instrumentation point for cost attribution. ETA: 2 sprints for core + 1 sprint for polishing export UX.

Maya (PM): owners and tentative dates:
- MVP spec and docs: Maya -> draft by 179999 + review by 180003
- Runtime hooks & sampling: Kim -> PR by 180030
- Data pipeline + aggregation: Nora -> PR by 180030
- Dashboards + CSV export: Diego + Kim -> initial by 180060
- Canary rollout plan & customers: Raj -> plan by 180010

Kim (Eng): small note — need funding approval for extra storage if we expand retention after MVP.

Raj (GTM): I can surface that with finance once we have rough numbers from Nora.

observability-bot: created ticket OBS-3821 (Console telemetry MVP) and linked to project board: https://redwood/board/obs

Maya (PM): thanks everyone — assuming no objections I'll lock this in and open PR for the spec today. please add any blockers inline. :thumbsup:

Kim (Eng): :thumbsup:

Diego (SRE): ok from infra side

Alix (Support): sending customer comms draft tomorrow

Nora (Data): starting schema MR now

Raj (GTM): will coordinate canary customers
